question: Does a broad point-in-time crypto time-series-momentum sleeve built only from already-frozen trend/risk definitions produce a useful standalone return stream with materially lower correlation to BRRK than another directional crypto-beta strategy?

signal.per_contract: same existing 20/60/120/240 time-series trend score used elsewhere in the project
signal.direction: continuous signed score; positive may be long and negative may be short

risk_normalization.own_rv30: rolling 30-day standard deviation of daily close-to-close simple returns using completed information
risk_normalization.portfolio_normalization: divide each day's raw weights by sum(abs(raw_weight)) so target gross is 1.0 when any valid signal exists

execution.timing: completed date-t target -> t+1 held exposure
execution.execution_availability: if the contract has no valid t+1 close-to-close return / archive row, actual held weight on that date is zero; remaining contracts are not renormalized using future availability

required_outputs: standalone daily equity and metrics at all fixed cost levels
turnover, average gross and average net exposure
average long/short gross and active long/short contract counts
daily and monthly Pearson/Spearman correlation to frozen BRRK-0011 over their common history
TSMOM returns during BRRK negative months and worst BRRK months
contribution concentration by contract and later-ended-contract contribution
full daily target/held diagnostics as artifact
explicit_limitations: This first mechanism is price-return plus fixed transaction-cost accounting only.
Native funding is not yet incorporated and is a mandatory next gate if the mechanism is economically interesting.
Binance funding must not be presented as a Hyperliquid point estimate based on prior cross-venue evidence.
prohibited: no changing trend horizons/weights after seeing results
no Top-N selection or named-coin whitelist
no asset concentration cap added after result
no stacking with BRRK or optimizing sleeve weight under this experiment
no selecting one transaction-cost level as the only reported result
no claim of deployment PNL before funding/venue execution audit
stopping_rule: Run this exact broad mechanism once. Do not rescue it with horizon, rank, cap or universe tuning on the same history. If weak or highly correlated to BRRK, preserve/reject it. If standalone quality and diversification are meaningful, the next authorized work is funding/implementation attribution before portfolio stacking.
